assertion.rationale: F13: privilege across the estate is inverted — Owner and ReadWrite.All exist where automation is fully automated, while seven documented least-privilege workload grants (data-api, mcp-tools, cost-ingest) exist nowhere in code. F7 and F8, this control's other two contributors, are now CLOSED (Task 9 and Task 10 respectively): mls-verifier is federated to its own environment:verify subject distinct from the deployer's (closing F7 — see 3.1.6/3.1.7), and the deployer's Graph grant is Application.ReadWrite.OwnedBy rather than .All (closing F8). Task 12 expresses five of F13's seven grants in least-privilege form: data-api and mcp-tools each get Log Analytics Reader and Security Reader scoped no wider than the role permits (LAW resource scope and subscription scope respectively — neither role has a narrower resource to bind to), mcp-tools gets Cost Management Reader, and data-api's SQL contained-database user and Fabric workspace Viewer grants are expressed via data/seed/sql/900-contained-users.sql and a new Add-FabricWorkspaceRoleAssignment function in infra/fabric/fabric-api.psm1. F13 remains open: the Cost Management service's Storage Blob Data Contributor grant is owned by Task 17 (F15) — its identity is workflow-created, not Bicep-created — and cost-ingest's Storage Blob Data Reader grant is blocked on F19 (cost-ingest has no Function App or identity anywhere in this repo's IaC despite infra-up.yml:31 claiming otherwise). F13 remains this control's sole remaining open contributor, carrying forward the same gapSeverity — five of seven grants landing does not close a finding defined as 'zero workload RBAC expressed in IaC' while two still are not.

recommendation: Close the remaining two grants: Task 17 (F15) for the Cost Management service's Storage Blob Data Contributor, and F19 (cost-ingest provisioned as a real Function App with an identity) before its Storage Blob Data Reader grant can exist. Then add a criterion asserting each principal holds exactly its expected roles and no others. F7 and F8's remediations (the verify environment split, and Application.ReadWrite.OwnedBy) are DONE, and five of F13's seven workload RBAC grants (data-api, mcp-tools — see F13's table) are DONE — Task 12.
